01 — The whole day

The day is bigger than the catch.

You remember more than the fish. The lake before sunrise. The stretch of river you keep going back to. The friend who came along. The lure that finally worked. The weather turning. The one that got away.

Cast Your Line gives those details a place to stay.

02 — Routes & places

Remember where the day took you.

Turn on optional GPS route tracking when you want a record of your movement through a place. Follow a river on foot. Walk a shoreline. Paddle a lake. Troll from a boat.

When the trip is over, the route becomes part of the memory.

No scoreboard required

Some trips are worth remembering even when nothing bites.

Some days are about the place. Some are about the person who came with you. Some are quiet mornings you needed more than you realized. Cast Your Line gives all of them a place in your fishing history.

04 — Personal by design

Your journal does not need an audience.

No public profile to build. No followers to collect. No leaderboard to chase. Keep the record because it matters to you.
